disposition_reason: Ten lactose-free dairy varieties with mean ± SD for 17 trace and toxic elements in Table 4.

study.design: Retail survey of 30 lactose-free dairy products in 10 varieties (3 each), elemental profile and intake assessment
study.origin: Cow milk products (origin of manufacture not stated)
lod: Table 3: LOD 0.001 ug/kg (Cd, Pb, As, Hg) to 1.323 (Na); LOQ 0.003 (Cd, Pb, As, Hg) as printed
study.qa: ERM-BD150 skimmed milk powder: Cd 94.74%, Pb 94.74%, recoveries 85.29 to 101.67%; non-certified elements spiked; validated per Eurachem

unresolved: Ca, Na, K and Mg (Table 4) are macro-minerals and are not recorded as findings; Li, Be, B, Ag, Sb, Tl, Bi were analyzed but are not in Table 4.
Table 3 LOD/LOQ column is labeled ug/kg but the text gives LODs of 0.001 to 1323 ug/kg (Na printed as 1.323 in the table), so the LOQ unit is uncertain; LOQs are noted, not used as lod_ugkg.
Results basis is not stated (about 0.5 g of sample digested; presumably as sold).
Hg was not certified in the reference material and was spiked for recovery.
